sources_note: 逐則列明原始來源及實際日期；公司功能與推出安排按公告歸因，未把供應商聲稱當作獨立成效。
sources_note_en: Original sources and actual dates accompany each story. Product and rollout claims are attributed to their issuers, not presented as independently tested results.
thesis: 從創作到搜尋投放：先確認開放範圍，再接好資料與流程
thesis_en: From creative work to search ads: check access, then connect data and workflows
thesis_note: 10篇已覆核新聞，涵蓋AI代理、創意工具、搜尋廣告、體育CTV及香港品牌資料實務。
thesis_note_en: 10 reviewed stories covering agents, creative tools, search advertising, sports CTV and Hong Kong product-data practice.

廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google推出Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，原生影片延長至15秒
items.title_en: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native video up to 15 seconds
items.summary: 11月5日公告加入多輪對話修改，API與商務平台開放，部分應用仍按方案推出。
items.summary_en: The November 5 release adds conversational edits, with API and business access while some app features roll out by plan.
highlights: 影片可按一秒單位設定3至15秒。
可在同一片段修改背景、光線或畫面比例，無須每次重新起稿。
highlights_en: Native duration can be set from 3 to 15 seconds in one-second steps.
The same clip can be revised for background, lighting or aspect ratio.
items.why: 短片團隊可先完成一個概念，再修改成不同版位素材，減少重複提交簡報的工序。
items.why_en: Video teams can develop one concept and revise it for placements, reducing repeated briefing steps.
items.next_step: 用已獲授權的商品參考照試做一個片段，逐格核對包裝字樣、人物及連續動作。
items.next_step_en: Test one clip with authorized product references and inspect packaging text, people and motion frame by frame.
items.detail: Google稱模型改善參考素材與角色一致性，這仍屬公司對能力的描述，並非每次輸出的保證。公告把API及商務平台的正式開放，與Gemini應用向Ultra訂戶推出的安排分開列明；各帳戶應查實際權限。快速運動、劇本急轉及複雜物理效果仍是待改善項目。正式廣告製作宜保留原始參考、修改紀錄及人手審核，不能只看示範片便判定可直接交付。
items.detail_en: Reference consistency is a vendor capability claim, not a guarantee. API/business availability differs from the Gemini app’s Ultra rollout. Google identifies fast action and complex physics as ongoing work. Retain references, revision history and human production checks.

items.title: LinkedIn逐步推出貼文表現總表，可跨帖比較並匯出資料
items.title_en: LinkedIn rolls out an exportable Post Performance Table for cross-post comparisons
items.summary: 11月3日產品文章介紹桌面版總表，把曝光、觀看及互動資料集中顯示。
items.summary_en: The November 3 product post introduces a desktop table consolidating impressions, viewing and engagement data.
highlights: 可比較觸及、觀看時間、新增追蹤者、收藏及站內傳送等指標。
總表可匯出，亦可按入單篇分析；手機版尚待推出。
highlights_en: Metrics include reach, watch time, followers gained, saves and LinkedIn sends.
The table supports export and individual post analysis; mobile is to follow.
items.why: 內容團隊可按相同期間比較題材與格式，減少逐篇抄錄，亦方便保存原生數據作分析。
items.why_en: Content teams can compare topics and formats over matching periods and retain native data without copying each post manually.
items.next_step: 到桌面Content Analytics查看是否已開放，匯出最近一段期間，再把曝光與收藏、傳送分開分析。
items.next_step_en: Check desktop Content Analytics for access, export a recent period and analyze impressions separately from saves and sends.
items.detail: 這次重點是把原有及新增分析集中到可比較的表格，不代表所有指標均於11月首次出現。LinkedIn把Sends定義為站內訊息分享次數，不能直接當作站外轉發或商機數。原文亦提醒區分既有網絡與網絡外觸及。功能採逐步開放，本報未登入或測試任何帳戶；團隊應保留匯出日期及分析期間，避免不同時間窗令跨帖比較失準。
items.detail_en: Consolidation does not make every metric new. Sends measures sharing in LinkedIn messages, not off-platform forwards or leads. Distinguish existing-network from outside-network exposure and retain export dates and reporting windows. No user account was inspected or tested here.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Perplexity公布Teammates持續任務代理，先向Max網頁用戶推出
items.title_en: Perplexity announces Teammates for ongoing work, initially on the web for Max users
items.summary: 11月4日官方文章描述代理可接續項目、分工並提交結果供審閱。
items.summary_en: The November 4 official post describes agents that carry projects forward, coordinate work and return results for review.
highlights: 可沿用Computer的項目、技能、記憶及已連接工具。
原文列明網頁先行、iOS稍後，並保留既有權限與審閱操作。
highlights_en: Agents build on Computer projects, skills, memory and connected tools.
The primary post specifies web first, iOS later, with existing permissions and review controls.
items.why: 行銷團隊可把持續監察與跟進工作寫成有交付物的任務，亦需要清楚指定何時須批准。
items.why_en: Marketing teams can define monitoring and follow-up as ongoing assignments with deliverables and approval boundaries.
items.next_step: 先選一項只讀競品監察，列出資料來源、交稿格式、停止條件及須人手決定的步驟。
items.next_step_en: Start with read-only competitor monitoring and define sources, output format, stop conditions and human decisions.
items.detail: 官方把廣告監察、客戶跟進及營運管理列為用途示例，這不是已驗證的客戶成效。Teammates可協調其他代理，使用者仍可查看進度、改變方向或接手操作。它沿用Computer既有的工具與項目權限，各代理的瀏覽器環境亦分開。近期報道對iOS開放時間的描述不一，本報採用原文的『稍後推出』，不把Free或Pro方案寫成已包含此功能。
items.detail_en: Marketing and sales examples are proposed uses, not verified customer outcomes. Users can inspect, redirect or take over work. Permissions follow Computer and browser environments are separate. This report follows the primary post’s iOS-later wording rather than conflicting secondary coverage.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Reddit測試搜尋結果廣告，先向部分合資格廣告主開放
items.title_en: Reddit tests search-result ads with selected eligible advertisers
items.summary: 11月3日公告把廣告放入搜尋情境，平台仍在評估用戶反應。
items.summary_en: The November 3 announcement places ads in search contexts while Reddit evaluates user response.
highlights: 測試沿用現有廣告定向能力。
咖啡及家居辦公只是情境相關的例子。
highlights_en: The test uses existing ad targeting capabilities.
Coffee and home-office examples illustrate contextual relevance.
items.why: 社群搜尋可成為接近需求表達的接觸點，投放團隊可開始整理適合問答情境的素材。
items.why_en: Community search offers a touchpoint near expressed demand; teams can prepare context-sensitive creative.
items.next_step: 先向帳戶代表確認資格，再以品牌合適的搜尋情境設小額測試及對照。
items.next_step_en: Confirm account eligibility before planning a small contextual test with a comparison group.
items.detail: 這次公告涉及搜尋結果頁的版位測試，並非所有廣告主都可即時使用。Reddit以咖啡器材及家居辦公的搜尋情境解釋相關性，沒有在這篇公告交代完整競價規則、地區名單或正式普及日期。編輯未把例子延伸成成效承諾，也未把它與其他AI購物廣告安排混為一談。品牌應先核實帳戶權限，再決定是否把預算分配到這個接觸點。
items.detail_en: This is a search-result placement test, not universal access. Examples explain relevance without specifying complete bidding rules, markets or a general-release date. Treat performance as an open measurement question and confirm account access first.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Koozee加入節點畫布與MCP，把服裝素材流程保存重用
items.title_en: Koozee adds a node canvas and MCP to reuse apparel visual workflows
items.summary: 11月5日更新讓團隊串連參考素材，並由支援的AI代理批量生成服裝圖片。
items.summary_en: The November 5 update connects reference assets and lets supported AI agents generate apparel images in batches.
highlights: Freeform Canvas可保存流程，再換入其他商品素材。
MCP以OAuth授權連接；公司稱兩項功能均已可用。
highlights_en: Freeform Canvas saves workflows for reuse with different products.
MCP connects through OAuth; the company says both features are available.
items.why: 電商團隊可把同一系列的製作步驟固定下來，同時保留每款商品的原圖及審批要求。
items.why_en: Ecommerce teams can standardize collection workflows while retaining original product photos and item-level approval requirements.
items.next_step: 用一款商品測試三個角度，核對版型、顏色與細節後才擴至系列，並限制外部代理權限。
items.next_step_en: Test three views of one item, verify cut, color and details, then scale to a collection with limited agent permissions.
items.detail: Quick Create把預設用途集中，例如試穿、平拍與場景更換；Canvas則讓使用者把每次輸出送往下一個步驟，形成可重用流程。MCP是連接AI與外部工具的協議，今次主打批量圖片生成，並不代表可無人審閱直接發布。公告圖片已標明AI生成模特兒。服裝材質、剪裁與商品資訊仍需以實物資料核對，本報沒有進行成品準確度或成本測試。
items.detail_en: Quick Create groups preset outcomes, while Canvas carries outputs through reusable steps. MCP connects external AI tools for batch generation, not automatic publication approval. Release images identify synthetic models. Check garment details against real product data; no accuracy or cost testing is claimed.

items.title: Instagram Edits推出Mac版，跨手機專案編輯仍待完成
items.title_en: Instagram Edits reaches Mac while cross-device project editing remains planned
items.summary: 11月6日直接報道引述官方公布，桌面版加入多軌剪輯及品牌字型匯入。
items.summary_en: A November 6 direct report cites Instagram’s announcement of multitrack desktop editing and brand-font imports.
highlights: macOS版提供多軌時間線及關鍵影格。
手機儲存的部分樣式可沿用，完整跨端專案編輯仍在開發。
highlights_en: The macOS version offers a multitrack timeline and keyframes.
Some saved mobile styles carry over; seamless cross-device project editing is still in development.
items.why: 短片團隊可評估在較大畫面完成精細剪輯，以及直接銜接Instagram發布的流程。
items.why_en: Short-video teams can assess precision desktop editing and a direct Instagram publishing workflow.
items.next_step: 先用非機密測試片核對字型、字幕與輸出；商用音樂逐首查授權。
items.next_step_en: Check fonts, captions and exports with a non-confidential test clip; verify music rights individually.
items.detail: 官方文章在本輪未能直接讀取，這篇採用Net Influencer對同一公布的完整直接報道，並保留來源限制。報道把macOS桌面版與未完成的跨端專案編輯分開，不能把部分樣式同步寫成專案已可任意切換裝置。團隊亦應另查音樂商用權、外掛及帳戶支援。編輯沒有進行產品試用，功能描述均按報道所引述的公司說法歸因。
items.detail_en: The official post could not be read directly, so this story uses the full dated direct report with that limitation. Style carryover does not establish seamless project transfer. Check commercial music rights and account support separately; no product test was performed.

items.title: 更進新聞：GS1香港峰會落幕，聚焦產品數位身分與跨境對接
items.title_en: Follow-up: GS1 Hong Kong summit concludes with product identity and buyer connections
items.summary: 11月6日活動新增落幕及買家對接消息，產品資料可信度成品牌實務重點。
items.summary_en: The November 6 event adds summit and buyer-connection developments, with trusted product data as a practical brand priority.
highlights: 內地品牌與跨境電商、香港零售商進行現場對接。
GS1以成分、產地及認證資料說明產品數位身分用途。
highlights_en: Mainland brands met cross-border platforms and Hong Kong retailers.
GS1 used ingredients, origin and certifications to explain product digital identity.
items.why: 品牌內容、商品主檔與可追溯資料若能對齊，較容易支援跨渠道產品介紹及買家查詢。
items.why_en: Aligned brand content, product records and traceability data can support channel presentations and buyer questions.
items.next_step: 挑一個SKU核對商品編碼、成分、產地及認證連結，確認各渠道引用同一資料。
items.next_step_en: Audit one SKU’s identifier, ingredients, origin and certification links across channels.
items.detail: 這篇跟進11月6日實際舉行的峰會及買家對接，沒有重刊上一期已報道的KPMG與GS1調查數字。GS1提出以既有Digital Link標準連結可信產品資料，並非當天發布新的二維碼標準。主辦方對AI推薦與信任的看法屬其論述，未構成銷售增長或搜尋排名的證據。品牌可先完成單一商品資料盤點，再評估如何讓零售商及消費者讀取。
items.detail_en: This follows the actual summit and buyer session, without repeating yesterday’s survey figures. Digital Link is an existing standard. The organiser’s views on AI recommendations are not evidence of sales lift or search ranking. Begin with a single-product data audit.
items.source: GS1 Hong Kong / PR Newswire APAC
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Strategus擴大PubMatic體育CTV合作，地域定向仍受庫存限制
items.title_en: Strategus expands PubMatic sports CTV partnership with inventory limits
items.summary: 11月5日公布把即時體育庫存與代管投放結合，支援按賽事及市場規劃。
items.summary_en: The November 5 announcement combines live-sports inventory with managed execution by event and market.
highlights: 規劃維度包括聯盟、隊伍及比賽時段。
DMA與ZIP定向須視庫存是否容許。
highlights_en: Planning dimensions include leagues, teams and game windows.
DMA and ZIP targeting depend on available inventory.
items.why: 本地服務品牌可把賽事熱度與服務範圍一併考慮，減少只按全國曝光量買入的盲點。
items.why_en: Local-service brands can assess sports attention alongside their service footprint.
items.next_step: 要求媒體夥伴列明目標市場的可買賽事、最低投放量及版位層級報告。
items.next_step_en: Ask partners for purchasable events, minimum spend and placement-level reports in the target market.
items.detail: 公告以美國賓夕法尼亞州Citadel Credit Union的2026世界盃投放作合作例子，沒有提供可獨立核對的銷售或回報數字。平台列出的能力包括賽程資料及節目、版位層級報告；實際可買到的地域粒度仍取決於庫存。香港品牌若考慮海外賽事投放，應先把服務市場、可買權利及量度方式逐項確認，不能假設所有賽事均有相同覆蓋。
items.detail_en: The release names a Pennsylvania credit-union World Cup campaign without reporting verified sales lift. Schedule data and granular reporting are described capabilities. Available geography still depends on inventory, so overseas buyers should check rights, markets and measurement.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 工具補讀：商湯SenseNova 6.8 Flash擴展設計格式，主動辦公示範仍屬研發版
items.title_en: Tool review: SenseNova 6.8 Flash expands design formats; proactive office demos remain internal
items.summary: 11月2日中文原稿介紹動態簡報與3D設計，實際使用條件需按功能分開理解。
items.summary_en: The November 2 Chinese release describes animated presentations and 3D design, with different conditions across features.
highlights: 設計輸出涵蓋Web、SVG、PPT、Three.js及Blender。
客戶跟進的主動互動示範標明內部研發版，3D流程需要本地環境。
highlights_en: Design formats include Web, SVG, PPT, Three.js and Blender.
Proactive customer-follow-up demos are labeled internal R&D; 3D work needs local setup.
items.why: 簡報及創意團隊可評估可繼續編輯的交付格式，同時把示範能力與現成服務分開列入採購要求。
items.why_en: Presentation and creative teams can assess editable outputs while separating demonstrated research capabilities from deployable services.
items.next_step: 先確認Design體驗及輸出格式，再以非機密簡報測試；如需Blender，先安排本地環境及覆核。
items.next_step_en: Confirm Design access and output formats, test a non-confidential brief, and prepare local setup and review for Blender.
items.detail: 原稿列出長期記憶與主動交互的辦公方向，客戶回訪及交接案例旁清楚註明使用小浣熊內部研發版，不能推斷全部用戶已有相同能力。Blender例子亦依賴本地環境及使用者多輪修訂。公司公布多項評測，本報沒有重做測試，因此不沿用領先其他模型的結論。這篇保留11月2日原始日期，作工具補讀，未把近日轉載當作新的推出事件。
items.detail_en: Customer follow-up and handover demonstrations explicitly use an internal R&D version. Blender requires local setup and user iterations. Vendor benchmark superiority is not independently reproduced here. This is a review of the November 2 release, not a new launch inferred from later coverage.

items.title: Priority宣布收購Fireberry，擬把CRM與雲端ERP串連
items.title_en: Priority announces Fireberry acquisition and planned CRM–ERP integration
items.summary: 11月5日公司公告擴展銷售、行銷自動化及服務能力，保留獨立方案。
items.summary_en: The November 5 company release expands sales, marketing automation and service capabilities while retaining a standalone option.
highlights: Fireberry把銷售、行銷及服務放在同一CRM。
整合後的AI代理及統一資料能力屬公告中的規劃。
highlights_en: Fireberry combines sales, marketing and service in one CRM.
Combined AI-agent and unified-data capabilities are described as planned benefits.
items.why: CRM與營運資料相接，會影響行銷團隊如何管理潛客、訂單與售後交接。
items.why_en: Connecting CRM and operations affects lead, order and service handoffs.
items.next_step: 現有客戶可向供應商索取整合時間表、資料權限及獨立方案的支援安排。
items.next_step_en: Existing customers should request integration timing, data permissions and standalone support details.
items.detail: Priority把這宗收購定位為業務管理產品組合的擴展。新聞稿使用未來式描述整合方案將提供的分析、AI代理及統一資料能力，未能據此判定每項功能已在所有客戶帳戶開放。獨立CRM的選項亦有保留。行銷主管現階段最實際的工作，是列出名單、活動、訂單與客戶服務之間的資料交接需求，再要求供應商交代實際可交付範圍。
items.detail_en: The issuer positions the deal as a portfolio expansion. Future-tense integration claims do not establish feature access for every customer. With a standalone CRM option retained, teams should map campaign, lead, order and service handoffs before committing to migration.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
